architecture_proofs.name: persistent-reference prototype
architecture_proofs.verdict: PASS on the bar; hypothesis reframed from survival to repair

largest_gap: a geometric descriptor cannot distinguish repeated features after a resize, so the only safe repair is one a human confirms - and nothing yet measures how often an engineer would accept the proposal.
notes: P0-C and P0-A PASS. Baseline element identity measured as strong on hard geometry (8/8 correct). Repair prototype measured as unsafe if automatic. P0-B, P0-D, P0-E remain unproven. No superiority claim.
wedge_note: Constrained in round 003: automatic repair is unsafe. A geometric matcher scored 1.0 on the WRONG hole; only an arbitrary margin threshold prevented a confident mis-repair. Repair = diagnosis + ranked candidates + explicit ambiguity, confirmed by the engineer.
rounds: round-003-repair: repair on hard geometry (PASS, repair constrained to human-confirmed)
